newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Seattle, Wash..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Seattle, Wash..

text.p: Limited Tax General Obligation Bonds, 1997, Series A SEALEDBIDSwill be received by the City of Seattle,
Washington, at the offices of the Finance Director, 102 Municipal Building, 600 Fourth Avenue, Seattle, Washington, until 8:30 a.m., Pacific standard time on

(or other date and time as may be communicated 24 hours in advance). Both the par amount and the amounts of Bonds maturing in individual years are preliminary and subject to change in accordance with the provisions of the Official Notice of Bond Sale. The bids will be acted on by the City Council at a special meeting on January 22, 1997.

The Bonds will be dated February 1, 1997, and will be fully registered, in book-entry form, initially registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee for DTC. The Bonds will mature on August 1 in the years 1997 through 2017. Individual purchases of the Bonds will be made in the denomination of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof.

The Bonds shall be purchased at no less than 98.5 percent of the aggregate principal amount. Interest rates bid shall be in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of one percent, or both, and no rate of interest for any maturity shall be less than the rate of interest for a prior maturity.
The approving legal opinion of Foster Pepper & Shefelman, Seattle, Washington, will be furnished, without cost, to
the purchaser of the Bonds. A no-litigation certificate will be included in the closing papers.
Further information on the Bonds, and copies of the complete Official Notice of Sale, Official Bid Form and Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained, upon
request, from the City's financial advisor, Seattle-
